title: [Snyk] SNYK-PYTHON-TORCH-10337828 in torch@2.11.0
description:
## Out-of-bounds Write

**Severity:** medium
**Package:** torch@2.11.0
**File:** `pyproject.toml`

**CVSS Score:** 4.8  
**Exploit Maturity:** proof-of-concept  
**Snyk Priority Score:** 347/1000

### CVEs
- [CVE-2025-3001](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-3001)

**Fix:** No automatic fix available. Review manually.

### Details
## Overview
[torch](https://pypi.org/project/torch) is a Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Out-of-bounds Write due to the `torch.lstm_cell` function. An attacker can corrupt memory by manipulating the function's input.

**Note:**
This is only exploitable if the attacker has local access to the system.
## Remediation
A fix was pushed into the `master` branch but not yet published.
## References
- [GitHub Commit](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/commit/999d94b5ede5f4ec111ba7dd144129e2c2725b03)

- [Vulnerable Code](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/2180e87d7cc567997fe663640bc12f341207f859/aten/src/ATen/native/RNN.cpp#L743-L749)
- [Vulnerable Code](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/f34ab1628b6798cc62f55260dfad872f5df8fd94/benchmarks/fastrnns/cells.py#L26)
